Wind Noise Reduction-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

AirPods mic wind-suppression marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general audio guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Wind Noise Control in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Official Settings vocabulary — 风噪抑制 and 风噪控制

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 风噪抑制 (wind noise suppression) for Wind Noise Reduction under Settings → Bluetooth → [Your AirPods]. Buyer forums also use 风噪控制 (wind noise control) and 麦克风风噪抑制 (microphone wind noise suppression) for outdoor call clarity. Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not generic 降噪 that could mean Active Noise Cancellation 主动降噪, Adaptive Audio 自适应音频, or environmental noise monitoring.

Wind Noise Reduction vs Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode

Noise Cancellation blocks ambient sound you hear with ANC — 主动降噪. Transparency mode passes ambient sound to your ears — 通透模式. Wind Noise Reduction suppresses wind buffeting on the earbud microphone during calls — 风噪抑制. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 主动降噪 or 通透模式 when your English source only shows Wind Noise Reduction under AirPods settings. See the Noise Cancellation listing guide only if ANC or Transparency listening modes are your lead marketing claims.

Wind Noise Reduction vs Adaptive Audio and Conversation Awareness

Adaptive Audio automatically blends ANC and Transparency based on environment — 自适应音频. Conversation Awareness lowers media when you start speaking to someone nearby — 对话感知. Wind Noise Reduction processes microphone input to reduce wind on outdoor calls — 风噪抑制. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 自适应音频 or 对话感知 when your English source only shows a Wind Noise Reduction toggle. See the Adaptive Audio listing guide only if environment-aware listening-mode blending is your lead marketing claim.

Wind Noise Reduction vs Headphone Accommodations and Conversation Boost

Headphone Accommodations tunes headphone EQ, amplify-soft-sounds processing, and hearing-level presets — 耳机调节, 放大轻柔声音. Conversation Boost amplifies voices in Transparency mode — 透明模式对话增强. Wind Noise Reduction suppresses wind on the mic during calls — not frequency EQ curves or voice amplification in Transparency. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 耳机调节 or 透明模式对话增强 when your English source only shows Wind Noise Control. See the Headphone Accommodations listing guide only if EQ tuning or conversation amplification is your lead claim.

Wind Noise Reduction vs Personalized Volume

Personalized Volume learns your preferred media loudness over time — 个性化音量. Wind Noise Reduction improves mic clarity on outdoor calls — 风噪抑制. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 个性化音量 when your English source only shows Wind Noise Control under AirPods settings. See the Personalized Volume listing guide only if volume-learning automation is your lead claim.

Wind Noise Reduction vs Stem Controls and Raise to Speak

Stem Controls cover Force Sensor press and squeeze on the AirPods stem — 杆控, 耳机柄控制. Raise to Speak activates Siri when you lift AirPods toward your mouth — 抬起讲话. Wind Noise Reduction is microphone wind processing, not stem-press playback or lift-to-talk input. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 杆控 or 抬起讲话 when your English source only shows outdoor mic wind suppression.
